newsitem.title: USA: Air Wisconsin March load factor rises.
newsitem.headline: Air Wisconsin March load factor rises.

text.p: Air Wisconsin Airlines Corp, operating as United Express, said Thursday its March passenger load factor rose 14.5 points to 67.0 percent from 52.5 percent.
Revenue passenger miles increased 25.5 percent to 55.9 million from 44.5 million, and available seat miles declined 1.6 percent to 83.4 million from 84.8 million.

Year to date, the carrier said its load factor was up 12.5 points to 60 percent from 47.5 percent. Revenue passenger miles rose 25 percent to 146 million from 116.8 million, and available seat miles fell one percent to 243.4 million from 245.9 million.
